MECP Cartesian gradient and reaction-coordinate definitions
Workflow mode = MECP_ONLY
Run mode = CLUSTER

Low-spin multiplicity  = 2 (doublet)
High-spin multiplicity = 4 (quartet)

Definitions:
deltaG_NAST = g_LS - g_HS
delta_g_cart = g_HS - g_LS
DELTAF_PARALLEL_EH_PER_BOHR = ||g_LS - g_HS||
CARTESIAN_GRADMEAN_EH_PER_BOHR = sqrt(||g_LS|| * ||g_HS||)
The final reaction-coordinate-projected GRADMEAN_EH_PER_BOHR is calculated later and is not defined in Step 4.
